name: ai-api-prices
description: MCP server and daily dataset of AI API list prices: LLM, image, video, speech, search and embeddings at every provider.
long_description: Look up standard USD list prices across 50+ AI providers (LLMs, image, video, transcription, text-to-speech, web search, and embeddings), estimate monthly workload bills, compare two models side by side, and browse category lows using daily open data from AISelect.online.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Search AI API models by name across text, image, video, transcription, tts, search, and embedding categories.

tools.name: model_prices
tools.description: List standard USD list prices for one AI model at every priced provider, ordered cheapest first.

tools.name: estimate_monthly_cost
tools.description: Estimate a monthly workload bill in USD across every priced provider for one model.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare two AI models in USD by each model's cheapest priced provider.

tools.name: cheapest_models
tools.description: List the cheapest AI models in a category in USD ranked by lowest provider price.
